correctness.rationale: SEP one-particle duality gives occupation covariance from e^{tQ}. Stationary particle–hole symmetry kills odd Walsh moments, fixing the complete three-bit joint law by correlations a,b; conditional endpoint independence is precisely b=a². Self-adjoint spectral representation makes b-a² a variance of e^{-lambda t}; after removing zero mode canonically, its vanishing iff e_x−1/L is an eigenvector is exactly a uniformly weighted universal hub. Fourier heat-kernel convergence, Taylor expansion of CMI, and Bessel asymptotics give both theta profiles, finite-ring exponential tail and 1/(16*pi*D*t) line tail. Fresh finite-state generator exponentiations independently verified 11 tests, including perturbed-hub contrast. General limits rest on analysis, not those tests.
residual_risks: Finite tests corroborate but do not replace the analytic infinite/domain-general proof.
